status: Retrospective method audit: previous results were known. Choices frozen before the new grid, not represented as prospective preregistration.
request: Audit adoption dates and weighting; align with supplied Krueger and JIBS studies; publish all specifications rather than select a desired sign.
date_policy: Preserve statutory/fiscal/publication distinctions. UK extended auditor reporting has information-policy year 2013 and covered-period start 2012. No invented actual filing dates.
primary_liquidity: Reviewed implementation calendar, outcome in following year versus prior year, GDP country weights, both family weights; complete fixed company sample. This adopts the t+1 outcome alignment in Krueger, not its unavailable firm controls/industry-year effects.
scope_reason: Information provided to outside users; exclude confidential tax reports, institutional/rotation rules, governance codes, entity registers and token authorisations from this mechanism-specific sensitivity. All families remain in the all-policy main comparison.
weight_audit: Show equal-minus-cap contribution differences, cap concentration, repeated cohort exposure and leave-one-family-out diagnostics. No weight chosen by sign.
support: At least 30 complete companies per country, one pre-event share line per vendor company, at least 3 comparison countries. Controlled WLS requires full rank and at least 3 residual degrees of freedom.
inference: Country-cluster influences and fixed-seed multiplier diagnostics; Holm across the full supported grid. Intervals condition on the calendar and do not establish exogenous adoption.
JIBS_primary: Lagged adoption-status logit; year and family effects; independently decided cases; paired equal/cap family masses; corrected learning edge cases with known-history requirements; separate and joint models. Show odds ratios.
JIBS_construct_limits: Language is a proxy, not Berry cultural/administrative distance. Exact IFAC histories, historical six-control set and a comparable ordinal adoption scale are unavailable; do not claim exact replication.
ESG_benchmark: Use supplied Krueger published complete E/S/G mandatory calendar separately; do not equate broader nonfinancial phases with the published complete-topic definition.
selection: Preserve unsupported cells and every sign. No ranking of models to choose the main estimate.

peer_universe_addendum.strict_result_seen: Joint model has no usable rows with complete histories for all ten closest world neighbours; retained as strict sensitivity.
peer_universe_addendum.adaptation_before_new_estimates: Select the ten nearest countries in each family-specific documented-history universe, using only distance and history availability. Keep original world-neighbour results. Main is reference-style joint status model using this declared observed-history network; it is not an exact replication or prospective preregistration.
peer_universe_addendum.units: Trade/language odds ratios per 10 percentage points; learning binary; external finance per percentage point of GDP.
peer_universe_addendum.controls: All six domestic-control domains downloaded or computed; usable years and missingness retained; no zero fill.

factor_sensitivity_addendum.reason: The supplied Krueger paper also uses one common illiquidity factor. Add as a measurement sensitivity, not a replacement chosen by model results.
factor_sensitivity_addendum.measurement: One-factor Gaussian ML on the pooled correlation matrix of the same three liquidity inputs; regression factor scores; sign oriented so higher spread implies higher factor. Single-factor rotation does not alter the factor space.
factor_sensitivity_addendum.inference: Linear combination of component main estimates and shared country influences on identical samples; four horizon/weight tests, all retained. Calendar-year adaptation, not exact fiscal-year replication.

known_boundaries.reason: Domestic entity reporting exemption; do not carry initial US phase forward as a stable domestic obligation.
Previously flagged reporting/enforcement history uncertainty. Conservative endpoint exclusion is not a claim that all due-diligence obligations ended.

history_endpoint_censor.rule: Exclude affected country from either comparison arm when a window ends in or after the flagged year; no recoding to untreated. Applies to every specification regardless of sign.
